web.title: What Is the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform? - Carly AI
web.description:
# What Is the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
Vertex AI is the old name.

## Two different things are called “Gemini Enterprise”
It is the renamed [Vertex AI Agent Builder](https://www.usecarly.com/blog/vertex-ai-agent-builder/), it bills on consumption rather than per seat, and you reach it through the Google Cloud console.

## FAQ
### Is Vertex AI discontinued?
It was renamed.
